request.spec:
Show for the sheet the due of OPEN and PENDING claims that count by age, as the people's age
buckets added up (0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 or more days), not trimmed.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show for the sheet the due of OPEN and PENDING claims that count by age, as the people's age
buckets added up (0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 or more days), not trimmed.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The sheet now shows its own age-bucket totals: the due of OPEN and PENDING claims that count, in 0 to 30, 31 to 60 and 61 or more days. Each total is every person's bucket added up, with nothing trimmed. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

The only file changed is `src/main/frontend/features/aged/aged.slot.tsx`:
- **Shared calculation:** I moved the per-person bucket calculation into a `useAged` hook, so the person columns and the sheet totals use the same numbers. This is the same pattern the overdue feature already uses.
- **Sheet totals:** a new `SheetAged` line sits in the home screen's main area, just above the tag and month totals, with `rollup-aged-0-30`, `rollup-aged-31-60` and `rollup-aged-61`.

The existing `person-aged-*` columns show the same values as before. No server, schema or audit changes were needed, because the sheet totals are worked out from data the screen already loads.
